The intact shared-view assistant won 67/120 vs 50/120 overall (p=.0300) and lost 29/48 vs 38/48 on fresh ordinary questions (p=.0490). The corrected single-adapter replay retained all 17 public calls and added two, but scored 45/72 vs 50/72 on fresh tasks and lost twelve earlier field successes. Its 74/144 vs 62/144 mixed difference had paired p=.148.
